items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Did he ever play with you? No, he played in the brass band.

ctx.x: Well what about Eddie Atkins? Did you ever know him?

Well yeah, he's over here. He used to play a trumpet with Eddie Atkins. Did he ever play with you? No, he played in the brass band. You know, sometimes he used to make up with a band, once or twice. Them fellas, Ed Atkins. But he's playing with different bands in town. Jack Kerrin. That's his brother. That's his brother. He used to play with Jack Kerrin. And I played one of two jobs with Jack Kerrin, too, on the way down around Lutches. Through there on the other side of the road, on the Isaiah side. Yeah, I…
Not shy, not shy, but we called it lancers. We used to play lancers at them time. You understand?
